name: Deore XT rear derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 265 g for the RD-M730 SGS super-long-cage assembly: the 1989 catalogue explicitly identifies this weight as SGS. It does not establish the GS weight. The documented 28–32T largest-sprocket range depends on Shimano SFR/SF fork ends; 32T is not an unconditional frame-independent limit.
